latestVersion.changelog:
akshare-online-alpha 1.0.0 initial release:

- Provides Wyckoff-style analysis for A-shares using online multi-source data with automatic source switching.
- Supports analysis from stock codes, CSVs, chart images, and portfolio holdings (symbol/cost/qty/cash/candidate).
- Enforces strict Beijing-time trading session checks before suggesting any trading actions.
- Automatically infers user intent (add/reduce/switch/cash-deployment) based on provided fields.
- Outputs follow a fixed contract: session info, data audit, Wyckoff analysis, portfolio actions, and plotting (when allowed).
- Implements robust error handling for data availability, structure depth, and image parsing.
